form.nameInfo: The company or organisation name for this client.
form.emailInfo: Primary email address for invoices and notifications.
form.mobileInfo: Primary contact number for the client representative.
form.notesInfo: Internal remarks — shown on detail pages but not on customer-facing documents.
form.paymentTermsInfo: Default payment terms applied to new invoices for this client.
form.tagsInfo: Categories used for filtering and grouping clients in reports.
form.activeInfo: Inactive clients are hidden from new transactions but remain on record.
form.billingCurrencyInfo: ISO 4217 currency the client is billed in. Defaults to workspace functional currency when blank.
